components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The definitive action for saving or confirming an operational change.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--green, #087a52); color: #fff; font: 800 12px/1.55 Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s ease, background .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green-dark, #075b40); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(233,139,42,.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action that remains visible without competing with the primary decision.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcded4); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #fffefa); color: var(--ink, #10241d); font: 800 12px/1.55 Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s ease, background .2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e9ece6; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(233,139,42,.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The standard RTL field for branch-scoped data entry and search.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">اسم اللاعب<input type="text" placeholder="اكتب الاسم الكامل"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink, #10241d); font: 700 12px/1.55 Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; direction: rtl; } .ds-field input { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcded4); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #10241d); font: 400 14px/1.55 Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--green, #087a52); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(8,122,82,.1); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(233,139,42,.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The clean-sheet active row inside the fixed pitch-ink sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 220px; min-height: 45px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #b7c5bf; font: 400 14px/1.55 Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; direction: rtl; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-active { background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #10241d); font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(233,139,42,.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Present Status
components.description: An explicit positive operational state; color supports rather than replaces its text.
components.css: .ds-status-present { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: max-content; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--green-soft, #dff1e8); color: var(--green-dark, #075b40); font: 900 12px/1.55 Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Attention Status
components.description: The compact label for late, pending, and near-capacity states.
components.css: .ds-status-attention { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: max-content; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--orange-soft, #fff0dc); color: #8a551d; font: 900 12px/1.55 Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Ledger Panel
components.description: A grouped operational surface on the warm paper workspace.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 320px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface, #fffefa); color: var(--ink, #10241d); box-shadow: 0 14px 38px rgba(21,44,36,.09); font-family: Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-panel header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 22px 24px 0; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; } .ds-panel p { margin: 2px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #53625b); font-size: 12px; } .ds-panel header > strong { font-size: 23px; } .ds-panel-rule { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 22px 24px; padding: 15px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #dcded4); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dcded4); } .ds-panel-rule span { color: var(--muted, #53625b); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Data Ledger
components.description: The ruled, horizontally resilient record table for players and financial activity.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcded4); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface, #fffefa); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(21,44,36,.05); font-family: Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--ink, #10241d); } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 15px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dcded4); text-align: right; font-size: 12px; } .ds-table th { background: #e9ece6; color: var(--muted, #53625b); } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f8f7f2; } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-table span { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--green-soft, #dff1e8); color: var(--green-dark, #075b40); font-weight: 900; }

narrative.overview:
This system turns a multi-branch academy dashboard into a warm paper operations ledger: authoritative, dense, and calm enough to scan under daily administrative pressure. Deep pitch ink supplies the structure, ruled separators keep records legible, and clean sheet surfaces sit on a warm paper field.

Pitch green communicates the academy's live operational state; decision orange is reserved for attention, capacity pressure, and next actions. The interface is Arabic-first and right-to-left, using the platform-safe Arabic system stack so the static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript prototype remains dependency-free.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper material with crisp, ruled ledger surfaces.
Deep pitch ink structure with controlled green and orange signals.
Branch context remains visible before operational and financial action.
Football geometry appears as a restrained structural cue, not fabricated brand artwork.

rules.name: The Decision Ink Rule
rules.body: Use green for routine operational truth and orange for decisions or attention; neither color is decorative fill.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Keep warm paper behind the workspace and clean sheet on record-bearing surfaces so boundaries remain readable without excessive chrome.

rules.name: The Arabic System Stack Rule
rules.body: Preserve Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif in that order and do not add a web-font dependency.

rules.name: The Number Scan Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for scoreboards and financial totals where columns or repeated values must compare at a glance.

rules.name: The Branch-First Rule
rules.body: Keep branch context visible in the sticky operating frame before users read or change branch-scoped records.

rules.name: The Ledger Density Rule
rules.body: Prefer shared ruled containers and compact 12px operational metadata over a loose field of individually floating cards.

rules.name: The Ruled-Before-Raised Rule
rules.body: Use border and tonal separation first; reserve shadows for grouped operating surfaces, overlays, and the highest-value summaries.

rules.name: The Tight-Control Rule
rules.body: Controls stay tighter than panels so actions and fields read as tools placed on the sheet, not as nested cards.

dos: Do preserve the warm paper, clean sheet, and ruled-line hierarchy across new operational screens.
Do keep Arabic RTL reading order, right-aligned records, readable 12px minimum operational labels, and keyboard-visible focus.
Do use pitch green for live and positive operations, decision orange for attention, and explicit text for every status.
Do reuse the fixed branch context, dense ledger rows, 14px panels, and 8px to 10px controls.
Do keep the product dependency-free: static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with the system Arabic font stack.
donts: Don't introduce external fonts, icon packages, frameworks, or fabricated academy assets.
Don't scatter every datum into a floating card or replace continuous table rules with excessive whitespace.
Don't use orange or green as broad decoration; their operational meaning depends on restraint.
Don't hide branch scope, bus capacity, overdue status, or financial exceptions behind secondary navigation.
Don't use football imagery as generic decoration; the implemented pitch geometry is the only established concept seed.
